            kprintln!("cache-alias probe failed: invalid MTRR state: {:?}", error);
            halt_forever();
        }
    };
    if !boot_info.cpu_info.normal_caching {
        kprintln!("cache-alias probe failed: non-normal CR0 caching mode");
        halt_forever();
    }
    verify_kernel_cache_aliases(
        boot_info,
        &reader,
        root,
        config,
        pat,
        &mtrrs,
        "kernel text",
        segments.text.virtual_start,
        segments.text.physical_start,
        segments.text.virtual_end - segments.text.virtual_start,
    );
    verify_kernel_cache_aliases(
        boot_info,
        &reader,
        root,
        config,
        pat,
        &mtrrs,
        "kernel rodata",
        segments.rodata.virtual_start,
        segments.rodata.physical_start,
        segments.rodata.virtual_end - segments.rodata.virtual_start,
    );
    verify_kernel_cache_aliases(
        boot_info,
        &reader,
        root,
        config,
        pat,
        &mtrrs,
        "kernel data",
        segments.data.virtual_start,
        segments.data.physical_start,
        segments.data.virtual_end - segments.data.virtual_start,
    );
    probe_cloned_page_tables(
        &mut boot_info.frame_allocator,
        &boot_info.memory_map,
        boot_info.hhdm_offset,
        physical_address_bits,
        boot_info.cpu_info.active_linear_address_bits,
        &reader,
        root,
        config,
        [
            (
                "kernel text",
                segments.text.virtual_start,
                segments.text.physical_start,
                segments.text.virtual_end - segments.text.virtual_start,
            ),
            (
                "kernel rodata",
                segments.rodata.virtual_start,
                segments.rodata.physical_start,
                segments.rodata.virtual_end - segments.rodata.virtual_start,
            ),
            (
                "kernel data",
                segments.data.virtual_start,
                segments.data.physical_start,
                segments.data.virtual_end - segments.data.virtual_start,
            ),
            (
                "active boot stack",
                boot_info.boot_stack_virtual_start,
                boot_info.boot_stack_physical_start,
                boot_info.boot_stack_virtual_end - boot_info.boot_stack_virtual_start,
            ),
        ],
    );
    probe_candidate_page_tables(boot_info);
}

#[cfg(feature = "probe-hhdm-frame")]
fn probe_cloned_page_tables(
    allocator: &mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
    memory_map: &rustix_kernel::memory::MemoryMap,
    hhdm_offset: u64,
    physical_address_bits: u8,
    virtual_address_bits: u8,
    source_reader: &impl rustix_kernel::paging::PageTableReader<
        Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError,
    >,
    source_root: rustix_kernel::paging::Cr3Root,
    config: rustix_kernel::paging::PageWalkConfig,
    spans: [(&str, u64, u64, u64); 4],
) {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::CandidatePageTables;

    let mut memory = LimineHhdmCandidateMemory {
        memory_map,
        hhdm_offset,
        physical_address_bits,
        virtual_address_bits,
    };
    let mut candidate = match CandidatePageTables::new(allocator, &mut memory, config) {
        Ok(candidate) => candidate,
        Err(error) => {
            kprintln!(
                "candidate clone probe failed to create root: {:?}",
                error.cause
            );
            if let Some(frame) = error.frame {
                release_probe_frame(allocator, frame);
            }
            halt_forever();
        }
    };
    if let Err(error) = candidate.clone_inherited_hierarchy(allocator, source_reader, source_root) {
        kprintln!("candidate clone probe failed: {:?}", error);
        release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, allocator);
    }
    for (label, virtual_start, physical_start, length) in spans {
        if !candidate_span_matches_source(
            &candidate,
            source_reader,
            source_root,
            config,
            virtual_start,
            physical_start,
            length,
        ) {
            kprintln!(
                "candidate clone probe failed: {} translation mismatch",
                label
            );
            release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, allocator);
        }
    }
    let table_count = candidate.table_count();
    if let Err(failure) = candidate.release(allocator) {
        kprintln!(
            "candidate clone probe failed to release frames: {:?}",
            failure
        );
        halt_forever();
    }
    kprintln!(
        "candidate inherited-root clone probe passed: {} owned table pages preserve critical paths; CR3 unchanged",
        table_count
    );
}

fn candidate_span_matches_source(
    candidate: &rustix_kernel::paging::CandidatePageTables<'_, LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'_>>,
    source_reader: &impl rustix_kernel::paging::PageTableReader<
        Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError,
    >,
    source_root: rustix_kernel::paging::Cr3Root,
    config: rustix_kernel::paging::PageWalkConfig,
    virtual_start: u64,
    physical_start: u64,
    length: u64,
) -> bool {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::{walk_virtual_address, PageWalkOutcome};

    let mut offset = 0;
    while offset < length {
        let Some(virtual_address) = virtual_start.checked_add(offset) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(expected_physical) = physical_start.checked_add(offset) else {
            return false;
        };
        let source_result =
            walk_virtual_address(source_reader, source_root, virtual_address, config);
        let candidate_result = candidate.walk(virtual_address);
        let (source_translation, candidate_translation) = match (source_result, candidate_result) {
            (Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(source)), Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(candidate))) => {
                (source, candidate)
            }
            (source, candidate) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "candidate clone walk mismatch at {:#018x}: inherited={:?}, candidate={:?}",
                    virtual_address,
                    source,
                    candidate
                );
                return false;
            }
        };
        if !source_translation.same_effective_mapping(candidate_translation)
            || candidate_translation.physical_address != expected_physical
        {
            kprintln!(
                "candidate clone translation mismatch at {:#018x}: inherited={:?}, candidate={:?}, expected PA={:#x}",
                virtual_address,
                source_translation,
                candidate_translation,
                expected_physical
            );
            return false;
        }
        let Some(next_offset) = offset.checked_add(rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE) else {
            return false;
        };
        offset = next_offset;
    }
    true
}

#[cfg(feature = "probe-hhdm-frame")]
fn probe_candidate_page_tables(boot_info: &mut boot::BootInfo) {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::{
        validate_mapping_range, CachePolicy, CandidatePageTables, PagePermissions, PageWalkOutcome,
    };

    let Some(physical_address_bits) = boot_info.cpu_info.physical_address_bits else {
        kprintln!("candidate page-table probe failed: physical width unknown");
        halt_forever();
    };
    if !boot_info.cpu_info.nx_enabled || !boot_info.cpu_info.normal_caching {
        kprintln!("candidate page-table probe failed: NXE or normal caching unavailable");
        halt_forever();
    }
    let pat_value = boot_info
        .cpu_info
        .pat_msr_value
        .expect("inherited cache-alias probe validated active PAT");
    let pat = rustix_kernel::paging::PatLayout::from_msr_value(pat_value).unwrap_or_else(|error| {
        kprintln!(
            "candidate page-table probe failed: invalid PAT: {:?}",
            error
        );
        halt_forever();
    });
    let registers = match &boot_info.cpu_info.mtrr {
        rustix_kernel::paging::MtrrState::Captured(registers) => registers,
        _ => {
            kprintln!("candidate page-table probe failed: captured MTRR state unavailable");
            halt_forever();
        }
    };
    let mtrrs = match registers.validated_layout(physical_address_bits) {
        Ok(mtrrs) => mtrrs,
        Err(error) => {
            kprintln!(
                "candidate page-table probe failed: invalid MTRR: {:?}",
                error
            );
            halt_forever();
        }
    };
    let config = rustix_kernel::paging::PageWalkConfig {
        levels: if boot_info.cpu_info.active_linear_address_bits == 57 {
            5
        } else {
            4
        },
        physical_address_bits,
        virtual_address_bits: boot_info.cpu_info.active_linear_address_bits,
        nx_enabled: true,
        page_2m_supported: true,
        page_1g_supported: boot_info.cpu_info.has_1g_pages,
    };
    let virtual_address = 0xffff_9000_ffff_f000;
    let permissions = PagePermissions {
        writable: true,
        executable: false,
        user_accessible: false,
    };
    let frame = match boot_info.frame_allocator.allocate() {
        Some(frame) => frame,
        None => {
            kprintln!("candidate page-table probe failed: no leaf frame available");
            halt_forever();
        }
    };
    let mapping = match validate_mapping_range(
        virtual_address,
        frame.address(),
        rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE,
        permissions,
        Some(physical_address_bits),
        config.virtual_address_bits,
    ) {
        Ok(mapping) => mapping,
        Err(error) => {
            kprintln!(
                "candidate page-table probe failed: invalid mapping: {:?}",
                error
            );
            release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, frame);
            halt_forever();
        }
    };
    let cache_attributes = match mapping.select_cache_attributes(
        CachePolicy::WriteBack,
        pat,
        &mtrrs,
        boot_info.cpu_info.normal_caching,
    ) {
        Ok(attributes) => attributes,
        Err(error) => {
            kprintln!(
                "candidate page-table probe failed: cache policy: {:?}",
                error
            );
            release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, frame);
            halt_forever();
        }
    };

    let mut memory = LimineHhdmCandidateMemory {
        memory_map: &boot_info.memory_map,
        hhdm_offset: boot_info.hhdm_offset,
        physical_address_bits,
        virtual_address_bits: boot_info.cpu_info.active_linear_address_bits,
    };
    let mut candidate =
        match CandidatePageTables::new(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, &mut memory, config) {
            Ok(candidate) => candidate,
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "candidate page-table probe failed to create root: {:?}",
                    error.cause
                );
                release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, frame);
                if let Some(root_frame) = error.frame {
                    release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, root_frame);
                }
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
    let root = candidate.root_physical_address();
    let frame_address = frame.address();
    if let Err(failure) = candidate.map_owned_page(
        &mut boot_info.frame_allocator,
        frame,
        mapping,
        cache_attributes,
    ) {
        kprintln!(
            "candidate page-table probe failed to map leaf: {:?}",
            failure.cause
        );
        release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, failure.frame);
        release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, &mut boot_info.frame_allocator);
    }

    let walk = candidate.walk(virtual_address);
    let returned_frame = match candidate.unmap_owned_page(virtual_address) {
        Ok(frame) => frame,
        Err(error) => {
            kprintln!(
                "candidate page-table probe failed to unmap leaf: {:?}",
                error
            );
            release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, &mut boot_info.frame_allocator);
        }
    };
    let translation_valid = match &walk {
        Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation)) => {
            translation.physical_address == frame_address
                && translation.page_size == rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE
                && translation.permissions == permissions
                && translation.pat_index == cache_attributes.pat_index()
        }
        _ => false,
    };
    if returned_frame.address() != frame_address {
        kprintln!("candidate page-table probe failed: unmap returned the wrong frame");
        release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, returned_frame);
        release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, &mut boot_info.frame_allocator);
    }
    release_probe_frame(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator, returned_frame);
    if !translation_valid {
        kprintln!(
            "candidate page-table probe failed: candidate walk: {:?}",
            walk
        );
        release_candidate_after_probe_failure(candidate, &mut boot_info.frame_allocator);
    }
    if let Err(failure) = candidate.release(&mut boot_info.frame_allocator) {
        kprintln!(
            "candidate page-table probe failed to release frames: {:?}",
            failure
        );
        halt_forever();
    }
    kprintln!(
        "candidate page-table probe passed: mapped, walked, unmapped, and released root {:#x}; CR3 unchanged",
        root.expect("candidate retains root until release")
    );
}

fn release_candidate_after_probe_failure(
    candidate: rustix_kernel::paging::CandidatePageTables<'_, LimineHhdmCandidateMemory<'_>>,
    allocator: &mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
) -> ! {
    if let Err(failure) = candidate.release(allocator) {
        kprintln!("candidate page-table cleanup also failed: {:?}", failure);
    }
    halt_forever()
}

#[cfg(feature = "probe-hhdm-frame")]
fn verify_inherited_mapping(
    reader: &impl rustix_kernel::paging::PageTableReader<
        Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError,
    >,
    root: rustix_kernel::paging::Cr3Root,
    config: rustix_kernel::paging::PageWalkConfig,
    label: &str,
    virtual_start: u64,
    physical_start: u64,
    length: u64,
) {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::{walk_virtual_address, PageWalkOutcome};

    let mut offset = 0;
    let mut pages = 0;
    let mut first_translation: Option<rustix_kernel::paging::PageTranslation> = None;
    let mut permissions_uniform = true;
    let mut pat_index_uniform = true;
    while offset < length {
        let virtual_address = match virtual_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!("inherited mapping probe failed: {} virtual overflow", label);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let expected_physical = match physical_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!(
                    "inherited mapping probe failed: {} physical overflow",
                    label
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let translation = match walk_virtual_address(reader, root, virtual_address, config) {
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation)) => translation,
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::NotPresent { level }) => {
                if level == rustix_kernel::paging::PageLevel::Pml4 {
                    let pml4_index = ((virtual_address >> 39) & 0x1ff) as u16;
                    let root_entry = reader.read_entry(root.physical_address(), pml4_index);
                    kprintln!(
                        "inherited mapping PML4 detail: VA={:#018x}, index={}, root={:#x}, entry={:?}",
                        virtual_address,
                        pml4_index,
                        root.physical_address(),
                        root_entry
                    );
                }
                kprintln!(
                    "inherited mapping probe failed: {} absent at {:?}",
                    label,
                    level
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!("inherited mapping probe failed: {}: {:?}", label, error);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        if translation.physical_address != expected_physical {
            kprintln!(
                "inherited mapping probe failed: {} {:#018x} mapped to {:#018x}, expected {:#018x}",
                label,
                virtual_address,
                translation.physical_address,
                expected_physical
            );
            halt_forever();
        }
        if let Some(first) = first_translation {
            permissions_uniform &= translation.permissions == first.permissions;
            pat_index_uniform &= translation.pat_index == first.pat_index;
        } else {
            first_translation = Some(translation);
        }
        pages += 1;
        offset += rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE;
    }
    if let Some(first) = first_translation {
        kprintln!(
            "inherited mapping probe passed: {} ({} pages), first permissions={:?}, PAT index={}, leaf size={}, uniform permissions={}, uniform PAT index={}",
            label,
            pages,
            first.permissions,
            first.pat_index,
            first.page_size,
            permissions_uniform,
            pat_index_uniform
        );
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "probe-hhdm-frame")]
fn verify_kernel_cache_aliases(
    boot_info: &boot::BootInfo,
    reader: &impl rustix_kernel::paging::PageTableReader<
        Error = rustix_kernel::memory::HhdmAddressError,
    >,
    root: rustix_kernel::paging::Cr3Root,
    config: rustix_kernel::paging::PageWalkConfig,
    pat: rustix_kernel::paging::PatLayout,
    mtrrs: &rustix_kernel::paging::ValidatedMtrrLayout,
    label: &str,
    kernel_virtual_start: u64,
    physical_start: u64,
    length: u64,
) {
    use rustix_kernel::paging::{walk_virtual_address, PageWalkOutcome};

    let mut offset = 0;
    let mut pages = 0;
    while offset < length {
        let physical = match physical_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!("cache-alias probe failed: {} physical overflow", label);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let kernel_virtual = match kernel_virtual_start.checked_add(offset) {
            Some(address) => address,
            None => {
                kprintln!("cache-alias probe failed: {} virtual overflow", label);
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let hhdm_virtual = match boot_info.memory_map.limine_hhdm_address(
            boot_info.hhdm_offset,
            physical,
            rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE,
            boot_info.cpu_info.physical_address_bits,
            boot_info.cpu_info.active_linear_address_bits,
        ) {
            Ok(address) => address,
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} HHDM range: {:?}",
                    label,
                    error
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let kernel_translation = match walk_virtual_address(reader, root, kernel_virtual, config) {
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation)) => translation,
            result => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} kernel walk: {:?}",
                    label,
                    result
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let hhdm_translation = match walk_virtual_address(reader, root, hhdm_virtual, config) {
            Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(translation)) => translation,
            result => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} HHDM walk: {:?}",
                    label,
                    result
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        if kernel_translation.physical_address != physical
            || hhdm_translation.physical_address != physical
        {
            kprintln!(
                "cache-alias probe failed: {} physical {:#018x} has inconsistent translations",
                label,
                physical
            );
            halt_forever();
        }
        let kernel_type = match mtrrs.effective_memory_type_for(
            physical,
            pat,
            kernel_translation.pat_index,
            boot_info.cpu_info.normal_caching,
        ) {
            Ok(memory_type) => memory_type,
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} kernel PAT/MTRR: {:?}",
                    label,
                    error
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        let hhdm_type = match mtrrs.effective_memory_type_for(
            physical,
            pat,
            hhdm_translation.pat_index,
            boot_info.cpu_info.normal_caching,
        ) {
            Ok(memory_type) => memory_type,
            Err(error) => {
                kprintln!(
                    "cache-alias probe failed: {} HHDM PAT/MTRR: {:?}",
                    label,
                    error
                );
                halt_forever();
            }
        };
        if kernel_type != hhdm_type {
            kprintln!(
                "cache-alias conflict: {} PA {:#018x}, kernel {:?} vs HHDM {:?}",
                label,
                physical,
                kernel_type,
                hhdm_type
            );
            halt_forever();
        }
        pages += 1;
        offset += rustix_kernel::paging::PAGE_SIZE;
    }
    kprintln!(
        "cache-alias probe passed: {} ({} pages; effective types match)",
        label,
        pages
    );
}

fn release_probe_frame(
    allocator: &mut rustix_kernel::frame::FrameAllocator,
    frame: rustix_kernel::frame::Frame,
) {
    if let Err(error) = allocator.deallocate(frame) {
        kprintln!(
            "HHDM frame probe failed to return its frame: {:?}",
            error.error
        );
        halt_forever();
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "inject-page-fault")]
fn run_fault_injection() {
    kprintln!("fault injection: triggering page fault at 0x00000000deadbeef");
    // SAFETY: This is an opt-in QEMU test that deliberately reads an unmapped
    // low virtual address; the installed page-fault handler is expected to halt.
    unsafe {
        core::arch::asm!(
            "mov rax, 0xdeadbeef",
            "mov rax, qword ptr [rax]",
            out("rax") _,
            options(nostack)
        );
    }
    kprintln!("fault injection unexpectedly returned");
    halt_forever();
}

#[cfg(feature = "inject-invalid-opcode")]
fn run_fault_injection() {
    kprintln!("fault injection: triggering invalid opcode with ud2");
    // SAFETY: This is an opt-in QEMU test that deliberately raises #UD; the
    // installed invalid-opcode handler is expected to halt.
    unsafe { core::arch::asm!("ud2", options(nomem, nostack)) };
    kprintln!("fault injection unexpectedly returned");
    halt_forever();
}

/// Set once the fatal panic path has started. A panic from inside the fatal
/// path stops silently instead of recursively printing or looping diagnostics.
static FATAL_PANIC_ACTIVE: core::sync::atomic::AtomicBool =
    core::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false);

#[panic_handler]
fn panic(info: &PanicInfo<'_>) -> ! {
    // Mask maskable interrupts before any diagnostics run: another kernel
    // thread must not resume after a panic is declared, and the fatal report
    // must not be preempted mid-print.
    //
    // SAFETY: Kernel panic path runs at CPL 0; masking IF is always sound.
    unsafe { core::arch::asm!("cli", options(nomem, nostack)) };
    if FATAL_PANIC_ACTIVE.swap(true, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) {
        loop {
            // SAFETY: Re-entrant panics are deliberately silent.
            unsafe { core::arch::asm!("cli; hlt", options(nomem, nostack)) };
        }
    }
    arch::x86_64::serial::initialize();
    kprintln!("KERNEL PANIC: {}", info);
    halt_forever()
}

fn halt_forever() -> ! {
    loop {
        // SAFETY: The bootstrap has no interrupt handlers or scheduler to resume.
        unsafe { core::arch::asm!("cli; hlt", options(nomem, nostack)) };
    }
}

//! Bounded parser for statically linked x86_64 ELF64 executables.
//!
//! This validates image metadata only. It does not allocate frames, apply
//! relocations, or install mappings into a process address space.

use core::convert::TryFrom;

pub const ELF64_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 64;
pub const ELF64_PROGRAM_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 56;
pub const MAX_ELF_PROGRAM_HEADERS: usize = 64;
pub const MAX_ELF_LOAD_SEGMENTS: usize = 16;
pub const MAX_ELF_LOAD_PAGES: usize = 64;
pub const PAGE_SIZE: u64 = 4096;

const ET_EXEC: u16 = 2;
const EM_X86_64: u16 = 62;
const PT_LOAD: u32 = 1;
const PT_DYNAMIC: u32 = 2;
const PT_INTERP: u32 = 3;
const PT_TLS: u32 = 7;
const PT_GNU_STACK: u32 = 0x6474_e551;
const PF_EXECUTE: u32 = 1;
const PF_WRITE: u32 = 2;
const PF_READ: u32 = 4;
const PF_MASK: u32 = PF_EXECUTE | PF_WRITE | PF_READ;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ElfError {
    TruncatedHeader,
    InvalidMagic,
    UnsupportedClass,
    UnsupportedByteOrder,
    UnsupportedVersion,
    UnsupportedObjectType,
    UnsupportedMachine,
    InvalidAddressWidth,
    InvalidHeaderSize,
    InvalidProgramHeaderSize,
    TooManyProgramHeaders,
    InvalidProgramHeaderTable,
    UnsupportedDynamicSegment,
    UnsupportedTlsSegment,
    ExecutableStackUnsupported,
    UnsupportedSegmentFlags,
    SegmentNotReadable,
    TooManyLoadSegments,
    InvalidSegmentSize,
    InvalidFileRange,
    InvalidVirtualRange,
    InvalidAlignment,
    WritableExecutableSegment,
    OverlappingLoadSegments,
    ImageTooLarge,
    NoLoadSegments,
    EntryNotExecutable,
}

#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ElfPagePopulationError<E> {
    InvalidSegment,
    InvalidPage,
    FrameMemory(E),
}

#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ElfLoadError<CacheError, TableError, FrameMemoryError> {
    OutOfFrames,
    Mapping(crate::paging::MappingError),
    CachePolicy(CacheError),
    Populate(ElfPagePopulationError<FrameMemoryError>),
    Map(crate::paging::ProcessPageMapError<TableError>),
}

/// A loader failure may leave earlier pages mapped in the inactive process root.
/// The caller owns `frame`, if present, and must reclaim it. Destroy the newly
/// created process root to reclaim `mapped_pages` and any retained page tables.
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ElfLoadFailure<CacheError, TableError, FrameMemoryError> {
    pub cause: ElfLoadError<CacheError, TableError, FrameMemoryError>,
    pub frame: Option<crate::frame::Frame>,
    pub mapped_pages: usize,
    pub rollback_retained_table_frames: usize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct LoadedElf {
    pub entry_point: u64,
    pub mapped_pages: usize,
}

/// One validated, page-aligned PT_LOAD segment in a static executable.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct Elf64LoadSegment {
    virtual_start: u64,
    virtual_end: u64,
    file_offset: usize,
    file_size: usize,
    memory_size: usize,
    page_end: u64,
    flags: u32,
}

impl Elf64LoadSegment {
    pub const fn virtual_start(self) -> u64 {
        self.virtual_start
    }

    pub const fn virtual_end(self) -> u64 {
        self.virtual_end
    }

    pub const fn file_offset(self) -> usize {
        self.file_offset
    }

    pub const fn file_size(self) -> usize {
        self.file_size
    }

    pub const fn memory_size(self) -> usize {
        self.memory_size
    }

    pub const fn page_end(self) -> u64 {
        self.page_end
    }

    pub const fn page_count(self) -> usize {
        ((self.page_end - self.virtual_start) / PAGE_SIZE) as usize
    }

    pub const fn writable(self) -> bool {
        self.flags & PF_WRITE != 0
    }

    pub const fn executable(self) -> bool {
        self.flags & PF_EXECUTE != 0
    }
}

/// A validated view into a static ELF64 image with fixed-capacity PT_LOAD metadata.
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct Elf64Image<'a> {
    bytes: &'a [u8],
    entry_point: u64,
    segments: [Option<Elf64LoadSegment>; MAX_ELF_LOAD_SEGMENTS],
    segment_count: usize,
    load_page_count: usize,
}

impl<'a> Elf64Image<'a> {
    pub fn parse(bytes: &'a [u8], virtual_address_bits: u8) -> Result<Self, ElfError> {
        if bytes.len() < ELF64_HEADER_SIZE {
            return Err(ElfError::TruncatedHeader);
        }
        if bytes.get(0..4) != Some(&b"\x7fELF"[..]) {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidMagic);
        }
        if bytes[4] != 2 {
            return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedClass);
        }
        if bytes[5] != 1 {
            return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedByteOrder);
        }
        if bytes[6] != 1 || read_u32(bytes, 20) != Some(1) {
            return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedVersion);
        }
        if read_u16(bytes, 16) != Some(ET_EXEC) {
            return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedObjectType);
        }
        if read_u16(bytes, 18) != Some(EM_X86_64) {
            return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedMachine);
        }
        if !matches!(virtual_address_bits, 48 | 57) {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidAddressWidth);
        }
        if read_u16(bytes, 52) != Some(ELF64_HEADER_SIZE as u16) {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidHeaderSize);
        }
        if read_u16(bytes, 54) != Some(ELF64_PROGRAM_HEADER_SIZE as u16) {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderSize);
        }

        let entry_point = read_u64(bytes, 24).ok_or(ElfError::TruncatedHeader)?;
        let program_header_offset = read_u64(bytes, 32).ok_or(ElfError::TruncatedHeader)?;
        let program_header_count =
            usize::from(read_u16(bytes, 56).ok_or(ElfError::TruncatedHeader)?);
        if program_header_count > MAX_ELF_PROGRAM_HEADERS {
            return Err(ElfError::TooManyProgramHeaders);
        }
        let program_header_offset = usize::try_from(program_header_offset)
            .map_err(|_| ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
        let program_header_bytes = program_header_count
            .checked_mul(ELF64_PROGRAM_HEADER_SIZE)
            .ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
        let program_header_end = program_header_offset
            .checked_add(program_header_bytes)
            .filter(|end| *end <= bytes.len())
            .ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;

        let lower_half_end = 1u64 << (virtual_address_bits - 1);
        let mut image = Self {
            bytes,
            entry_point,
            segments: [None; MAX_ELF_LOAD_SEGMENTS],
            segment_count: 0,
            load_page_count: 0,
        };

        for header_offset in
            (program_header_offset..program_header_end).step_by(ELF64_PROGRAM_HEADER_SIZE)
        {
            let kind = read_u32(bytes, header_offset).ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
            match kind {
                PT_DYNAMIC | PT_INTERP => return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedDynamicSegment),
                PT_TLS => return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedTlsSegment),
                PT_GNU_STACK => {
                    let flags = read_u32(bytes, header_offset + 4)
                        .ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
                    if flags & PF_EXECUTE != 0 {
                        return Err(ElfError::ExecutableStackUnsupported);
                    }
                }
                PT_LOAD => {
                    image.add_load_segment(header_offset, virtual_address_bits, lower_half_end)?
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }

        if image.segment_count == 0 {
            return Err(ElfError::NoLoadSegments);
        }
        if !image.segments().any(|segment| {
            segment.executable()
                && !segment.writable()
                && entry_point >= segment.virtual_start
                && entry_point < segment.virtual_end
        }) {
            return Err(ElfError::EntryNotExecutable);
        }
        Ok(image)
    }

    fn add_load_segment(
        &mut self,
        header_offset: usize,
        virtual_address_bits: u8,
        lower_half_end: u64,
    ) -> Result<(), ElfError> {
        if self.segment_count == MAX_ELF_LOAD_SEGMENTS {
            return Err(ElfError::TooManyLoadSegments);
        }
        let flags =
            read_u32(self.bytes, header_offset + 4).ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
        if flags & !PF_MASK != 0 {
            return Err(ElfError::UnsupportedSegmentFlags);
        }
        if flags & PF_READ == 0 {
            return Err(ElfError::SegmentNotReadable);
        }
        if flags & (PF_WRITE | PF_EXECUTE) == (PF_WRITE | PF_EXECUTE) {
            return Err(ElfError::WritableExecutableSegment);
        }

        let file_offset =
            read_u64(self.bytes, header_offset + 8).ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
        let virtual_start =
            read_u64(self.bytes, header_offset + 16).ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
        let file_size =
            read_u64(self.bytes, header_offset + 32).ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
        let memory_size =
            read_u64(self.bytes, header_offset + 40).ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;
        let alignment =
            read_u64(self.bytes, header_offset + 48).ok_or(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)?;

        if file_size > memory_size {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidSegmentSize);
        }
        if memory_size == 0 {
            if file_size == 0 {
                return Ok(());
            }
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidSegmentSize);
        }
        if (file_offset | virtual_start) & (PAGE_SIZE - 1) != 0 {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidAlignment);
        }
        if alignment > 1
            && (!alignment.is_power_of_two()
                || file_offset % alignment != virtual_start % alignment)
        {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidAlignment);
        }

        let file_offset = usize::try_from(file_offset).map_err(|_| ElfError::InvalidFileRange)?;
        let file_size = usize::try_from(file_size).map_err(|_| ElfError::InvalidFileRange)?;
        if file_offset
            .checked_add(file_size)
            .is_none_or(|end| end > self.bytes.len())
        {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidFileRange);
        }

        let virtual_end = virtual_start
            .checked_add(memory_size)
            .ok_or(ElfError::InvalidVirtualRange)?;
        let last_virtual = virtual_end - 1;
        if virtual_start < PAGE_SIZE
            || virtual_start >= lower_half_end
            || last_virtual >= lower_half_end
            || !is_canonical(virtual_start, virtual_address_bits)
            || !is_canonical(last_virtual, virtual_address_bits)
        {
            return Err(ElfError::InvalidVirtualRange);
        }
        let page_end = virtual_end
            .checked_add(PAGE_SIZE - 1)
            .map(|end| end & !(PAGE_SIZE - 1))
            .filter(|end| *end <= lower_half_end)
            .ok_or(ElfError::InvalidVirtualRange)?;
        let page_count_u64 = (page_end - virtual_start) / PAGE_SIZE;
        let page_count = usize::try_from(page_count_u64).map_err(|_| ElfError::ImageTooLarge)?;
        self.load_page_count = self
            .load_page_count
            .checked_add(page_count)
            .filter(|count| *count <= MAX_ELF_LOAD_PAGES)
            .ok_or(ElfError::ImageTooLarge)?;
        if self
            .segments()
            .any(|segment| virtual_start < segment.page_end && segment.virtual_start < page_end)
        {
            return Err(ElfError::OverlappingLoadSegments);
        }

        let memory_size = usize::try_from(memory_size).map_err(|_| ElfError::ImageTooLarge)?;
        self.segments[self.segment_count] = Some(Elf64LoadSegment {
            virtual_start,
            virtual_end,
            file_offset,
            file_size,
            memory_size,
            page_end,
            flags,
        });
        self.segment_count += 1;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub const fn entry_point(&self) -> u64 {
        self.entry_point
    }

    pub const fn segment_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.segment_count
    }

    pub const fn load_page_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.load_page_count
    }

    pub fn segments(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = Elf64LoadSegment> + '_ {
        self.segments[..self.segment_count]
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .copied()
    }

    pub fn segment_file_bytes(&self, index: usize) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
        let segment = self.segments.get(index)?.as_ref()?;
        let end = segment.file_offset.checked_add(segment.file_size)?;
        self.bytes.get(segment.file_offset..end)
    }

    /// Populate one page of a validated load segment, zero-filling bytes not
    /// covered by the segment's file payload (including BSS).
    pub fn populate_segment_page<U: crate::paging::UserFrameMemory>(
        &self,
        segment_index: usize,
        page_index: usize,
        frame: &crate::frame::Frame,
        user_memory: &mut U,
    ) -> Result<(), ElfPagePopulationError<U::Error>> {
        let segment = self
            .segments
            .get(segment_index)
            .and_then(Option::as_ref)
            .copied()
            .ok_or(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidSegment)?;
        if page_index >= segment.page_count() {
            return Err(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidPage);
        }

        let page_offset = page_index
            .checked_mul(PAGE_SIZE as usize)
            .ok_or(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidPage)?;
        let file_end = page_offset
            .checked_add(PAGE_SIZE as usize)
            .ok_or(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidPage)?
            .min(segment.file_size);
        let file_start = page_offset.min(file_end);
        let mut page = [0; PAGE_SIZE as usize];
        if file_start < file_end {
            let bytes = self
                .segment_file_bytes(segment_index)
                .ok_or(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidSegment)?;
            let source = bytes
                .get(file_start..file_end)
                .ok_or(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidSegment)?;
            page[..source.len()].copy_from_slice(source);
        }
        user_memory
            .copy_to_frame(frame, 0, &page)
            .map_err(ElfPagePopulationError::FrameMemory)
    }

    /// Allocate, populate, and map every validated PT_LOAD page into an inactive
    /// process root. Cache attributes are selected separately for each exact
    /// physical page by `select_cache_attributes`.
    ///
    /// On failure, pages already installed remain owned by the process root and
    /// are reported in `mapped_pages`; any returned frame remains caller-owned.
    /// Destroy a newly created root to reclaim partial mappings and retained page
    /// tables before abandoning a failed load.
    pub fn load_into_process_root<M, U, F, CacheError>(
        &self,
        roots: &mut crate::paging::ProcessAddressSpaceRoots<'_, '_, '_, M>,
        allocator: &mut crate::frame::FrameAllocator,
        handle: crate::paging::ProcessAddressSpaceHandle,
        user_memory: &mut U,
        mut select_cache_attributes: F,
    ) -> Result<LoadedElf, ElfLoadFailure<CacheError, M::Error, U::Error>>
    where
        M: crate::paging::CandidatePageTableMemory,
        U: crate::paging::UserFrameMemory,
        F: FnMut(
            crate::paging::ValidatedMappingRange,
        ) -> Result<crate::paging::SelectedCacheAttributes, CacheError>,
    {
        use crate::paging::{validate_mapping_range, PagePermissions, PAGE_SIZE};

        let config = roots.page_walk_config();
        let mut mapped_pages = 0;
        for (segment_index, segment) in self.segments().enumerate() {
            let permissions = PagePermissions {
                writable: segment.writable(),
                executable: segment.executable(),
                user_accessible: true,
            };
            for page_index in 0..segment.page_count() {
                let virtual_address = u64::try_from(page_index)
                    .ok()
                    .and_then(|index| index.checked_mul(PAGE_SIZE))
                    .and_then(|offset| segment.virtual_start().checked_add(offset));
                let Some(virtual_address) = virtual_address else {
                    return Err(ElfLoadFailure {
                        cause: ElfLoadError::Mapping(crate::paging::MappingError::AddressOverflow),
                        frame: None,
                        mapped_pages,
                        rollback_retained_table_frames: 0,
                    });
                };
                let Some(frame) = allocator.allocate() else {
                    return Err(ElfLoadFailure {
                        cause: ElfLoadError::OutOfFrames,
                        frame: None,
                        mapped_pages,
                        rollback_retained_table_frames: 0,
                    });
                };
                let mapping = match validate_mapping_range(
                    virtual_address,
                    frame.address(),
                    PAGE_SIZE,
                    permissions,
                    Some(config.physical_address_bits),
                    config.virtual_address_bits,
                ) {
                    Ok(mapping) => mapping,
                    Err(error) => {
                        return Err(ElfLoadFailure {
                            cause: ElfLoadError::Mapping(error),
                            frame: Some(frame),
                            mapped_pages,
                            rollback_retained_table_frames: 0,
                        });
                    }
                };
                let cache_attributes = match select_cache_attributes(mapping) {
                    Ok(attributes) => attributes,
                    Err(error) => {
                        return Err(ElfLoadFailure {
                            cause: ElfLoadError::CachePolicy(error),
                            frame: Some(frame),
                            mapped_pages,
                            rollback_retained_table_frames: 0,
                        });
                    }
                };
                if let Err(error) =
                    self.populate_segment_page(segment_index, page_index, &frame, user_memory)
                {
                    return Err(ElfLoadFailure {
                        cause: ElfLoadError::Populate(error),
                        frame: Some(frame),
                        mapped_pages,
                        rollback_retained_table_frames: 0,
                    });
                }
                if let Err(failure) =
                    roots.map_user_page(allocator, handle, frame, mapping, cache_attributes)
                {
                    return Err(ElfLoadFailure {
                        cause: ElfLoadError::Map(failure.cause),
                        frame: Some(failure.frame),
                        mapped_pages,
                        rollback_retained_table_frames: failure.rollback_retained_table_frames,
                    });
                }
                mapped_pages += 1;
            }
        }
        Ok(LoadedElf {
            entry_point: self.entry_point(),
            mapped_pages,
        })
    }
}

fn is_canonical(address: u64, address_bits: u8) -> bool {
    let sign_bit = (address >> (address_bits - 1)) & 1;
    let upper_bits = address >> address_bits;
    let expected_upper_bits = if sign_bit == 0 {
        0
    } else {
        u64::MAX >> address_bits
    };
    upper_bits == expected_upper_bits
}

fn read_u16(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u16> {
    let end = offset.checked_add(2)?;
    let bytes = bytes.get(offset..end)?;
    Some(u16::from_le_bytes([bytes[0], bytes[1]]))
}

fn read_u32(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    let end = offset.checked_add(4)?;
    let bytes = bytes.get(offset..end)?;
    Some(u32::from_le_bytes([bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2], bytes[3]]))
}

fn read_u64(bytes: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u64> {
    let end = offset.checked_add(8)?;
    let bytes = bytes.get(offset..end)?;
    Some(u64::from_le_bytes([
        bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2], bytes[3], bytes[4], bytes[5], bytes[6], bytes[7],
    ]))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{Elf64Image, ElfError, ElfPagePopulationError, MAX_ELF_LOAD_PAGES, PAGE_SIZE};
    use crate::frame::{Frame, FrameAllocator};
    use crate::memory::{MemoryMap, RawMemoryRegion};

    const FILE_SIZE: usize = 0x3000;
    const CODE_PH: usize = 64;
    const DATA_PH: usize = CODE_PH + 56;

    fn valid_elf() -> [u8; FILE_SIZE] {
        let mut bytes = [0; FILE_SIZE];
        bytes[..4].copy_from_slice(b"\x7fELF");
        bytes[4] = 2;
        bytes[5] = 1;
        bytes[6] = 1;
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 16, 2);
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 18, 62);
        put_u32(&mut bytes, 20, 1);
        put_u64(&mut bytes, 24, 0x4000_0000);
        put_u64(&mut bytes, 32, CODE_PH as u64);
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 52, 64);
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 54, 56);
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 56, 2);
        set_load_segment(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 5, 0x1000, 0x4000_0000, 64, 128, 0x1000);
        set_load_segment(
            &mut bytes,
            DATA_PH,
            6,
            0x2000,
            0x4000_1000,
            128,
            0x1800,
            0x1000,
        );
        bytes[0x1000..0x1040].fill(0x90);
        bytes[0x2000..0x2080].fill(0x5a);
        bytes
    }

    fn set_load_segment(
        bytes: &mut [u8],
        header: usize,
        flags: u32,
        file_offset: u64,
        virtual_address: u64,
        file_size: u64,
        memory_size: u64,
        alignment: u64,
    ) {
        put_u32(bytes, header, 1);
        put_u32(bytes, header + 4, flags);
        put_u64(bytes, header + 8, file_offset);
        put_u64(bytes, header + 16, virtual_address);
        put_u64(bytes, header + 32, file_size);
        put_u64(bytes, header + 40, memory_size);
        put_u64(bytes, header + 48, alignment);
    }

    fn put_u16(bytes: &mut [u8], offset: usize, value: u16) {
        bytes[offset..offset + 2].copy_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }

    fn put_u32(bytes: &mut [u8], offset: usize, value: u32) {
        bytes[offset..offset + 4].copy_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }

    fn put_u64(bytes: &mut [u8], offset: usize, value: u64) {
        bytes[offset..offset + 8].copy_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }

    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
    enum SyntheticFrameError {
        WrongFrame,
        OutOfBounds,
    }

    struct SyntheticFrameMemory {
        frame_address: u64,
        bytes: [u8; PAGE_SIZE as usize],
    }

    // SAFETY: This test backend accesses only its matching synthetic frame token
    // and enforces page bounds for every operation.
    unsafe impl crate::paging::UserFrameMemory for SyntheticFrameMemory {
        type Error = SyntheticFrameError;

        fn copy_from_frame(
            &mut self,
            frame: &Frame,
            offset: usize,
            destination: &mut [u8],
        ) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
            let end = offset
                .checked_add(destination.len())
                .filter(|end| *end <= self.bytes.len())
                .ok_or(SyntheticFrameError::OutOfBounds)?;
            if frame.address() != self.frame_address {
                return Err(SyntheticFrameError::WrongFrame);
            }
            destination.copy_from_slice(&self.bytes[offset..end]);
            Ok(())
        }

        fn copy_to_frame(
            &mut self,
            frame: &Frame,
            offset: usize,
            source: &[u8],
        ) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
            let end = offset
                .checked_add(source.len())
                .filter(|end| *end <= self.bytes.len())
                .ok_or(SyntheticFrameError::OutOfBounds)?;
            if frame.address() != self.frame_address {
                return Err(SyntheticFrameError::WrongFrame);
            }
            self.bytes[offset..end].copy_from_slice(source);
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_static_x86_64_load_segments_and_exposes_file_bytes() {
        let bytes = valid_elf();
        let image = Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(image.entry_point(), 0x4000_0000);
        assert_eq!(image.segment_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(image.load_page_count(), 3);
        let mut segments = image.segments();
        let code = segments.next().unwrap();
        let data = segments.next().unwrap();
        assert!(segments.next().is_none());
        assert_eq!(code.virtual_start(), 0x4000_0000);
        assert!(code.executable());
        assert!(!code.writable());
        assert_eq!(data.virtual_start(), 0x4000_1000);
        assert!(data.writable());
        assert!(!data.executable());
        assert_eq!(data.virtual_end(), 0x4000_2800);
        assert_eq!(data.memory_size(), 0x1800);
        assert_eq!(data.page_end(), 0x4000_3000);
        assert_eq!(image.segment_file_bytes(1).unwrap(), &[0x5a; 128]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn populates_file_bytes_and_zero_fills_each_segment_page() {
        let bytes = valid_elf();
        let image = Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48).unwrap();
        let memory_map = MemoryMap::from_raw(&[RawMemoryRegion {
            base: 0x10_0000,
            length: PAGE_SIZE * 2,
            kind: 0,
        }])
        .unwrap();
        let mut allocator = FrameAllocator::from_memory_map(&memory_map).unwrap();
        let frame = allocator.allocate().unwrap();
        let mut user_memory = SyntheticFrameMemory {
            frame_address: frame.address(),
            bytes: [0xa5; PAGE_SIZE as usize],
        };

        image
            .populate_segment_page(1, 0, &frame, &mut user_memory)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&user_memory.bytes[..128], &[0x5a; 128]);
        assert!(user_memory.bytes[128..].iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0));

        user_memory.bytes.fill(0xa5);
        image
            .populate_segment_page(1, 1, &frame, &mut user_memory)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(user_memory.bytes.iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0));
        assert_eq!(
            image.populate_segment_page(1, 2, &frame, &mut user_memory),
            Err(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidPage)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            image.populate_segment_page(16, 0, &frame, &mut user_memory),
            Err(ElfPagePopulationError::InvalidSegment)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_bad_identification_machine_and_object_type() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        bytes[4] = 1;
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedClass)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 18, 3);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedMachine)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 16, 3);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedObjectType)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_truncated_header_and_program_header_table() {
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&[0; 32], 48),
            Err(ElfError::TruncatedHeader)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u64(&mut bytes, 32, u64::MAX);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderTable)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 56, u16::MAX);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::TooManyProgramHeaders)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_segment_file_bounds_and_size_mismatch() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(
            &mut bytes,
            CODE_PH,
            5,
            0x1000,
            0x4000_0000,
            129,
            128,
            0x1000,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidSegmentSize)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 5, 0x3000, 0x4000_0000, 64, 128, 0x1000);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidFileRange)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_writable_executable_or_unreadable_load_segments() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 7, 0x1000, 0x4000_0000, 64, 128, 0x1000);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::WritableExecutableSegment)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 1, 0x1000, 0x4000_0000, 64, 128, 0x1000);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::SegmentNotReadable)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_unaligned_and_overlapping_load_pages() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 5, 0x1001, 0x4000_0000, 64, 128, 0x1000);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidAlignment)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(
            &mut bytes,
            DATA_PH,
            6,
            0x2000,
            0x4000_0000,
            128,
            0x1000,
            0x1000,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::OverlappingLoadSegments)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_user_range_overflow_noncanonical_and_unexecutable_entry() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u64(&mut bytes, 24, 0x8000_0000_0000);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::EntryNotExecutable)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(
            &mut bytes,
            CODE_PH,
            5,
            0x1000,
            u64::MAX & !0xfff,
            64,
            128,
            0x1000,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidVirtualRange)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u64(&mut bytes, 24, 0x4000_1000);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::EntryNotExecutable)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_dynamic_tls_and_executable_stack_program_headers() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u32(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 3);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedDynamicSegment)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u32(&mut bytes, DATA_PH, 7);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedTlsSegment)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u32(&mut bytes, DATA_PH, 0x6474_e551);
        put_u32(&mut bytes, DATA_PH + 4, 7);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::ExecutableStackUnsupported)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_invalid_header_encoding_and_sizes() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        bytes[0] = 0;
        assert_eq!(Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48), Err(ElfError::InvalidMagic));
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        bytes[5] = 2;
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedByteOrder)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        bytes[6] = 0;
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedVersion)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 52, 63);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidHeaderSize)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u16(&mut bytes, 54, 55);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidProgramHeaderSize)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_invalid_segment_flags_alignment_and_empty_load_table() {
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(
            &mut bytes,
            CODE_PH,
            0x8,
            0x1000,
            0x4000_0000,
            64,
            128,
            0x1000,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::UnsupportedSegmentFlags)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 5, 0x1000, 0x4000_0000, 64, 128, 0x1800);
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidAlignment)
        );
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        put_u32(&mut bytes, CODE_PH, 0);
        put_u32(&mut bytes, DATA_PH, 0);
        assert_eq!(Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48), Err(ElfError::NoLoadSegments));
    }

    #[test]
    fn enforces_fixed_load_page_capacity_and_address_width() {
        assert_eq!(
            Elf64Image::parse(&valid_elf(), 47),
            Err(ElfError::InvalidAddressWidth)
        );
        assert_eq!(MAX_ELF_LOAD_PAGES, 64);
        let mut bytes = valid_elf();
        set_load_segment(
            &mut bytes,
            DATA_PH,
            6,
            0x2000,
            0x4000_1000,
            128,
            65 * 4096,
            0x1000,
        );
        assert_eq!(Elf64Image::parse(&bytes, 48), Err(ElfError::ImageTooLarge));
    }
}

//! Checked x86_64 mapping policy and a bounded owned page-table builder.
//!
//! Pure helpers validate addresses, permissions, and cache policy. Candidate
//! table access is delegated to an unsafe backend contract. This module never
//! writes CR3; callers may activate a validated hierarchy through the explicit
//! unsafe ownership marker after performing their architecture-specific switch.

use crate::frame::{Frame, FrameAllocator, FrameError};
use crate::memory::{
    is_canonical_virtual_address, physical_range_fits_address_width, HhdmAddressError, MemoryMap,
    RegionKind, ValidatedAcpiSpan, ValidatedMmioSpan,
};

/// Base page size supported by the initial Rustix mapping policy.
pub const PAGE_SIZE: u64 = 4096;

/// The physical root address and interpretation of CR3's low bits.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Cr3Root {
    physical_address: u64,
    low_bits: Cr3LowBits,
}

impl Cr3Root {
    pub const fn physical_address(self) -> u64 {
        self.physical_address
    }

    pub const fn low_bits(self) -> Cr3LowBits {
        self.low_bits
    }
}

/// CR3's low bits are either a PCID or the paging-structure cache controls.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Cr3LowBits {
    Pcid(u16),
    CacheControls {
        page_level_write_through: bool,
        page_level_cache_disable: bool,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Cr3Error {
    UnknownPhysicalAddressWidth,
    InvalidPhysicalAddressWidth,
    InvalidRootAddress,
    ReservedBits,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Cr3RootAccessError {
    NotBootloaderReclaimable,
    Hhdm(HhdmAddressError),
}

/// Decode the currently active CR3 value without dereferencing its root table.
///
/// The caller supplies the reported physical-address width and whether CR4.PCIDE
/// is active, since those determine the valid address and low-bit encodings.
/// Encode a replacement CR3 value while preserving the active low-bit mode.
///
/// PCID is retained but the no-flush bit is always cleared so the selected PCID
/// is invalidated on load. Legacy PWT/PCD controls are preserved unchanged.
pub fn encode_cr3_value(
    root_physical_address: u64,
    low_bits: Cr3LowBits,
    physical_address_bits: u8,
) -> Result<u64, Cr3Error> {
    if !(12..=MAX_PTE_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS_BITS).contains(&physical_address_bits) {
        return Err(Cr3Error::InvalidPhysicalAddressWidth);
    }
    let root_end = root_physical_address
        .checked_add(PAGE_SIZE)
        .ok_or(Cr3Error::InvalidRootAddress)?;
    if root_physical_address & (PAGE_SIZE - 1) != 0
        || !physical_range_fits_address_width(
            root_physical_address,
            root_end,
            physical_address_bits,
        )
    {
        return Err(Cr3Error::InvalidRootAddress);
    }
    let low = match low_bits {
        Cr3LowBits::Pcid(pcid) if pcid <= 0x0fff => u64::from(pcid),
        Cr3LowBits::Pcid(_) => return Err(Cr3Error::ReservedBits),
        Cr3LowBits::CacheControls {
            page_level_write_through,
            page_level_cache_disable,
        } => {
            (u64::from(page_level_write_through) << 3) | (u64::from(page_level_cache_disable) << 4)
        }
    };
    Ok(root_physical_address | low)
}

pub fn parse_cr3_root(
    raw: u64,
    physical_address_bits: Option<u8>,
    pcid_enabled: bool,
) -> Result<Cr3Root, Cr3Error> {
    let physical_address_bits =
        physical_address_bits.ok_or(Cr3Error::UnknownPhysicalAddressWidth)?;
    if !(12..=MAX_PTE_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS_BITS).contains(&physical_address_bits) {
        return Err(Cr3Error::InvalidPhysicalAddressWidth);
    }

    let physical_mask = ((1u64 << physical_address_bits) - 1) & !(PAGE_SIZE - 1);
    let low_mask = if pcid_enabled {
        PAGE_SIZE - 1
    } else {
        (1 << 3) | (1 << 4)
    };
    if raw & !(physical_mask | low_mask) != 0 {
        return Err(Cr3Error::ReservedBits);
    }

    let low_bits = if pcid_enabled {
        Cr3LowBits::Pcid((raw & (PAGE_SIZE - 1)) as u16)
    } else {
        Cr3LowBits::CacheControls {
            page_level_write_through: raw & (1 << 3) != 0,
            page_level_cache_disable: raw & (1 << 4) != 0,
        }
    };

    Ok(Cr3Root {
        physical_address: raw & physical_mask,
        low_bits,
    })
}

/// Calculate the protocol-backed HHDM address of Limine's inherited root page.
///
/// This requires the root page to be wholly contained in bootloader-reclaimable
/// memory, as specified for Limine page tables. It does not dereference the page
/// or prove that the active hierarchy contains the HHDM mapping.
pub fn inherited_cr3_root_hhdm_address(
    root: Cr3Root,
    memory_map: &MemoryMap,
    hhdm_offset: u64,
    physical_address_bits: Option<u8>,
    virtual_address_bits: u8,
) -> Result<u64, Cr3RootAccessError> {
    let physical_start = root.physical_address();
    let physical_end = physical_start
        .checked_add(PAGE_SIZE)
        .ok_or(Cr3RootAccessError::Hhdm(HhdmAddressError::AddressOverflow))?;
    if !memory_map.range_is_within_region_kind(
        physical_start,
        physical_end,
        RegionKind::BootloaderReclaimable,
    ) {
        return Err(Cr3RootAccessError::NotBootloaderReclaimable);
    }
    memory_map
        .limine_hhdm_address(
            hhdm_offset,
            physical_start,
            PAGE_SIZE,
            physical_address_bits,
            virtual_address_bits,
        )
        .map_err(Cr3RootAccessError::Hhdm)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PageLevel {
    Pml5,
    Pml4,
    Pdpt,
    Pd,
    Pt,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PageWalkConfig {
    pub levels: u8,
    pub physical_address_bits: u8,
    pub virtual_address_bits: u8,
    pub nx_enabled: bool,
    pub page_2m_supported: bool,
    pub page_1g_supported: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PageTranslation {
    pub physical_address: u64,
    pub leaf_physical_base: u64,
    pub page_size: u64,
    pub permissions: PagePermissions,
    pub pat_index: u8,
    pub raw_leaf_entry: u64,
}

impl PageTranslation {
    /// Compare effective mapping policy while allowing equivalent large-page splits.
    ///
    /// Physical address, permissions, PAT index, global/software flags, and
    /// other stable leaf attributes must match. Leaf size, physical base, and
    /// hardware-maintained accessed/dirty bits may differ after a page split.
    pub const fn same_effective_mapping(self, other: Self) -> bool {
        const IGNORED_LEAF_BITS: u64 = PTE_ADDRESS_FIELD_MASK | (1 << 5) | (1 << 6) | (1 << 7);

        self.physical_address == other.physical_address
            && self.permissions.writable == other.permissions.writable
            && self.permissions.executable == other.permissions.executable
            && self.permissions.user_accessible == other.permissions.user_accessible
            && self.pat_index == other.pat_index
            && self.raw_leaf_entry & !IGNORED_LEAF_BITS == other.raw_leaf_entry & !IGNORED_LEAF_BITS
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PageWalkOutcome {
    NotPresent { level: PageLevel },
    Mapped(PageTranslation),
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PageTableEntryError {
    PhysicalAddressOutOfRange,
    NxDisabled,
    LargePageUnsupported,
    LargePageAtInvalidLevel,
    LargePageMisaligned,
}

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PageWalkError<E> {
    InvalidConfiguration,
    NonCanonicalAddress,
    InvalidRoot,
    InvalidEntry {
        level: PageLevel,
        error: PageTableEntryError,
    },
    Reader(E),
}

/// Read one raw entry from a table at a validated physical page address.
pub trait PageTableReader {
    type Error;

    fn read_entry(&self, table_physical: u64, index: u16) -> Result<u64, Self::Error>;
}

/// Translate one virtual address by following at most five page-table entries.
///
/// The reader owns all physical-memory access policy. This walker does not turn
/// physical addresses into pointers, modify tables, or infer effective cache
/// types from the leaf PAT selector.
pub fn walk_virtual_address<R: PageTableReader>(
    reader: &R,
    root: Cr3Root,
    virtual_address: u64,
    config: PageWalkConfig,
) -> Result<PageWalkOutcome, PageWalkError<R::Error>> {
    if !(12..=MAX_PTE_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS_BITS).contains(&config.physical_address_bits)
        || (config.levels != 4 && config.levels != 5)
        || config.virtual_address_bits != if config.levels == 4 { 48 } else { 57 }
    {
        return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidConfiguration);
    }
    if !is_canonical_virtual_address(virtual_address, config.virtual_address_bits) {
        return Err(PageWalkError::NonCanonicalAddress);
    }
    let root_physical = root.physical_address();
    let root_end = root_physical
        .checked_add(PAGE_SIZE)
        .ok_or(PageWalkError::InvalidRoot)?;
    if root_physical & (PAGE_SIZE - 1) != 0
        || !physical_range_fits_address_width(root_physical, root_end, config.physical_address_bits)
    {
        return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidRoot);
    }

    const PRESENT: u64 = 1;
    const WRITABLE: u64 = 1 << 1;
    const USER: u64 = 1 << 2;
    const WRITE_THROUGH: u64 = 1 << 3;
    const CACHE_DISABLE: u64 = 1 << 4;
    const PAGE_SIZE_OR_PAT: u64 = 1 << 7;
    const LARGE_PAGE_PAT: u64 = 1 << 12;
    const NO_EXECUTE: u64 = 1 << 63;
    const ADDRESS_FIELD_MASK: u64 = 0x000f_ffff_ffff_f000;

    let physical_mask = ((1u64 << config.physical_address_bits) - 1) & !(PAGE_SIZE - 1);
    let mut table_physical = root_physical;
    let mut writable = true;
    let mut user_accessible = true;
    let mut executable = true;
    let mut level_number = config.levels;

    loop {
        let shift = 12 + 9 * (level_number - 1);
        let index = ((virtual_address >> shift) & 0x1ff) as u16;
        let entry = reader
            .read_entry(table_physical, index)
            .map_err(PageWalkError::Reader)?;
        let level = match level_number {
            5 => PageLevel::Pml5,
            4 => PageLevel::Pml4,
            3 => PageLevel::Pdpt,
            2 => PageLevel::Pd,
            1 => PageLevel::Pt,
            _ => return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidConfiguration),
        };
        if entry & PRESENT == 0 {
            return Ok(PageWalkOutcome::NotPresent { level });
        }

        let address_field = entry & ADDRESS_FIELD_MASK;
        if address_field & !physical_mask != 0 {
            return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidEntry {
                level,
                error: PageTableEntryError::PhysicalAddressOutOfRange,
            });
        }
        if !config.nx_enabled && entry & NO_EXECUTE != 0 {
            return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidEntry {
                level,
                error: PageTableEntryError::NxDisabled,
            });
        }
        writable &= entry & WRITABLE != 0;
        user_accessible &= entry & USER != 0;
        executable &= entry & NO_EXECUTE == 0;

        let large_page = level_number > 1 && entry & PAGE_SIZE_OR_PAT != 0;
        let leaf_shift = if level_number == 1 {
            12
        } else if large_page && level_number == 2 && config.page_2m_supported {
            21
        } else if large_page && level_number == 3 && config.page_1g_supported {
            30
        } else if large_page && level_number <= 3 {
            return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidEntry {
                level,
                error: PageTableEntryError::LargePageUnsupported,
            });
        } else if large_page {
            return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidEntry {
                level,
                error: PageTableEntryError::LargePageAtInvalidLevel,
            });
        } else {
            table_physical = address_field;
            level_number -= 1;
            continue;
        };

        if large_page {
            let reserved_alignment_bits = ((1u64 << leaf_shift) - 1) & !0x1fff;
            if entry & reserved_alignment_bits != 0 {
                return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidEntry {
                    level,
                    error: PageTableEntryError::LargePageMisaligned,
                });
            }
        }
        let page_size = 1u64 << leaf_shift;
        let leaf_physical_base = address_field & !(page_size - 1);
        let leaf_physical_end =
            leaf_physical_base
                .checked_add(page_size)
                .ok_or(PageWalkError::InvalidEntry {
                    level,
                    error: PageTableEntryError::PhysicalAddressOutOfRange,
                })?;
        if !physical_range_fits_address_width(
            leaf_physical_base,
            leaf_physical_end,
            config.physical_address_bits,
        ) {
            return Err(PageWalkError::InvalidEntry {
                level,
                error: PageTableEntryError::PhysicalAddressOutOfRange,
            });
        }
        let pat_bit = if large_page {
            entry & LARGE_PAGE_PAT != 0
        } else {
            entry & PAGE_SIZE_OR_PAT != 0
        };
        let pat_index = (u8::from(pat_bit) << 2)
            | (u8::from(entry & CACHE_DISABLE != 0) << 1)
            | u8::from(entry & WRITE_THROUGH != 0);
        return Ok(PageWalkOutcome::Mapped(PageTranslation {
            physical_address: leaf_physical_base | (virtual_address & (page_size - 1)),
            leaf_physical_base,
            page_size,
            permissions: PagePermissions {
                writable,
                executable,
                user_accessible,
            },
            pat_index,
            raw_leaf_entry: entry,
        }));
    }
}
